title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file blocked by read-set enforcement on spec file
description: patch_file call on '.moeb/specifications/moeb/moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path.md' during the Per-Step Review Sub-Loop returned 'write_file rejected: exists on disk but has not been read during this run.' The spec file was created with write_file in Phase 4 and not added to the read set, so patch_file was rejected by read-set enforcement. The intended improvement (adding no-signal-reoccurrence to the rubric table) was not applied.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why <patch_file> failed and whether the intended operation completed. If a file write was not applied, a write_file fallback or retry is required before the next run succeeds. Additionally: add an explicit read_file call for the spec file path immediately after write_file in Phase 4 to add it to the read set before the review sub-loop begins.
